description: Clark Kent moves to Metropolis, joins the Daily Planet and creates the public identity of Superman while working beside reporter Lois Lane. Their partnership develops into romance as Clark protects the city, guards his secret and faces threats ranging from Lex Luthor to Kryptonian and time-traveling adversaries. Season 2 in this collection runs from "Madame Ex" through "And the Answer Is...", preserving the collection-local episode order and source runtimes.

s02e01.description: Luthor's ex-wife hires a Lois look-alike to discredit Lois and destroy Superman. In this Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman episode, "Madame Ex" develops that conflict through season 2 and carries its consequences into the surrounding story.

s02e02.description: An award nomination creates a rift between Clark and Lois; strange sounds cripple the city and Superman.

s02e03.description: While trying to get Lois reinstated in her job, Lois and Clark uncover political and corporate corruption.

s02e04.description: When Lois receives mysterious gifts, she and Clark link them to the creation of a nuclear weapon. In this Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman episode, "The Prankster" develops that conflict through season 2 and carries its consequences into the surrounding story.

s02e05.description: An international crime group targets Lois and her uncle; a prosecutor lusts for Clark but despises Superman.

s02e06.description: A blackout is linked to a computer genius and a colonel set to hijack a satellite that can destroy the world.

s02e07.description: Clark is mortally injured when a genetic experiment regenerates three infamous mobsters and a lethal gun moll.

s02e08.description: A misfit gains powers equal to Superman's; a deranged scientist wants to transform them to a Superman foe.

s02e09.description: A bitter inventor's new toy brings out the worst in the shoppers of Metropolis during the holiday season.

s02e10.description: Superman must fight a cyborg powered by kryptonite. In this Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman episode, "Metallo" develops that conflict through season 2 and carries its consequences into the surrounding story.

s02e11.description: Superman copes with Far East mysticism when Chinatown robberies are linked to a Ninja master. In this Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman episode, "Chi of Steel" develops that conflict through season 2 and carries its consequences into the surrounding story.

s02e12.description: After acquiring a device that carries information on a beam of light, Lois is kidnapped by an evil ophthalmologist.

s02e13.description: Lex Luthor returns from the grave to win back Lois and exact revenge on Superman. In this Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman episode, "The Phoenix" develops that conflict through season 2 and carries its consequences into the surrounding story.

s02e14.description: An assassin posing as a TV journalist attempts to reveal Superman's identity and kill him. In this Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman episode, "Top Copy" develops that conflict through season 2 and carries its consequences into the surrounding story.

s02e15.description: The Prankster jeopardizes Lois' interview with the president. In this Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman episode, "Return of the Prankster" develops that conflict through season 2 and carries its consequences into the surrounding story.

s02e16.description: Superman unwittingly aids the hijacking of a shipment of nuclear warheads; Clark and Lois ready for their first date.

s02e17.description: A deranged scientist plots to release a deadly virus in Metropolis; Lois' attraction to a government agent irks Clark.

s02e18.description: H.G. Wells' time machine carries Lois and Clark to 1966 Smallville to prevent a futuristic villain from killing the infant Superman.

s02e19.description: Jimmy falls under the influence of a mind-controlling serum that turns its victims into assassins who kill on command.

s02e20.description: After exposure to red kryptonite, a depressed Superman doesn't respond when Intergang kidnaps Perry.

s02e21.description: Lois must choose Clark, Superman or Dan Scardino; a lawsuit threatens Superman's future. In this Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman episode, "Whine, Whine, Whine" develops that conflict through season 2 and carries its consequences into the surrounding story.

s02e22.description: A blackmailer threatens to reveal Clark's secret; Clark proposes to Lois. In this Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman episode, "And the Answer Is..." develops that conflict through season 2 and carries its consequences into the surrounding story.
